title: Data: Temporary voluntary compensation contracts reduce wild meat sales in a zoonotic disease hotspot
description: De-identified data for a field experiment with informal restaurant owners in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire (2025), its twelve-month follow-up (2026), and a companion online donation experiment (Prolific, 2025). Version 1 contains the cleaned datasets; the full replication package will be added after publication.
